title: Bird Silhouette SVG Bundle, Heron, Swallow, Hummingbird, Wren, Flock of Birds Cut Files for Cricut, Silhouette (svg, dxf, png)
description:
Six original bird silhouette cut files for bird lovers: a heron standing among reeds, a swallow in flight, a hummingbird feeding at a flower, a wren on a branch, a flock of birds in flight cut from a round disc, and a heron in flight. Bold, simple shapes read clearly even when small.

Each design is a single-layer, single-path cut file with every part joined, so nothing falls out. Use them for decals, wall art, signs, cards, laser-cut wood or acrylic, and more.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 6 designs: Heron and Reeds, Swallow in Flight, Hummingbird and Flower, Wren on a Branch, Flock of Birds in Flight (disc), Heron in Flight
• SVG: Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Designer Edition, Inkscape, Illustrator
• DXF: Silhouette Studio Basic Edition, laser software (inches)
• PNG: transparent background, 1800 px on the longest side (6 in at 300 DPI)

SIZE
Default size is about 6 in on the longest side. Fine tips taper to about 0.08 in at 6 in; we recommend 5 in or larger for cardstock and vinyl and 6 in for laser-cut wood or acrylic.

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on up to 500 finished physical items per design. Please don't share or resell the digital files.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. Files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP.

Listing photos include digital mockups; you receive the digital files shown.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand for clean cuts.
